teaser: You square the edges of a pile of papers before setting it down, out of habit more than need. Life path 4 built that habit into you long before ESTJ gave it a name. The 4 wants a world that holds its shape; the Executive type wants to be the one holding it. Crossed together, there is less tension here than in most pairings — the number hands the type a reason to build, and the type hands the number a method for building it. What shows up instead is a particular kind of weight: a person who does not just want order, but takes responsibility for it, out loud, in front of others.
